hints.title: Define Probability of K Heads
hints.text: State represents the exact probability of achieving k heads after considering a prefix of coins.

hints.title: Incorporate Each Coin Transition
hints.text: For a coin with head probability p, k heads comes from (k - 1) heads flipping head, or k heads flipping tail.

hints.title: Update Backwards to Save Memory
hints.text: Iterate k downwards from target to 0 for each coin to update the probability array in place.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: target: desired count of head flips
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all 2^N coin flip combinations is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 1D probability rolling array computes the exact target probability in O(N * target) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle base case dp[0] = 1.0 and backward updates to prevent overwriting.
